references.text: The Passover lamb was to be slaughtered on the fourteenth day of the month, between the two evenings, just as described in Leviticus 23:5
Confirmation of the timing for the Passover celebration: the fourteenth day of the first month
Reiterates the instruction to celebrate Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month, between the two evenings
The fourteenth day of the first month is the Lord's Passover
Keep the Feast of Unleavened Bread in the month of Abib, when the Lord brought Israel out of Egypt
The children of Israel celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the month after entering Canaan
King Josiah celebrated Passover for the Lord in Jerusalem
Those who had returned from exile celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month
Prophetic description of the Passover celebration on the fourteenth day of the first month
Jesus celebrated the Passover meal with his disciples, fulfilling the Passover commandment
The disciples prepared the Passover meal on the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread
On the day when the Passover lamb had to be slaughtered, Jesus sent Peter and John to prepare the Passover meal
Jesus was crucified on the day of preparation for Passover, as the true Passover lamb
Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed – fulfilling the meaning of the Passover offering
